# Douyin Web Music Videos API

Fetches Douyin music video feeds using pagination controls. Specify the number of items per page with `count` and paginate using `refresh_index`.

## Use cases

- Retrieve video items associated with Douyin music content.
- Paginate through music video listings on Douyin Web.
- Collect Douyin video feeds for content tracking and analysis.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/douyin/web/music-aweme" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"count": "<count>"}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `count` | integer | Yes | Number per page, default is 16 |
| `refresh_index` | integer | No | Paging index, default is 1 |

## Notes

- `count` defines the number of items returned per page, defaulting to 16.
- `refresh_index` specifies the pagination index, defaulting to 1.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.

## Related APIs

- [Douyin sec_user_ids from URLs (Batch)](/model/douyin/web/all-sec-user-id): Extracts Douyin sec_user_id values in bulk from a list of user homepage URLs.
- [Douyin Webcast ID Extraction](/model/douyin/web/all-webcast-id): Extracts webcast IDs from a submitted list of Douyin live room links.
